capabilities.film.title: Film & motion
capabilities.film.short: Films that give an idea a life of its own.
capabilities.film.description: Campaign films, brand stories and moving images, with our team shaping the performance, composition and rhythm of the edit.
capabilities.film.note: From the first frame to the last cut.
capabilities.imagery.title: Stills & imagery
capabilities.imagery.short: Something to catch your eye and hold it.
capabilities.imagery.description: A single image or a whole campaign. Our art direction carries through the composition, lighting and final retouching.
capabilities.imagery.note: Ready for print, screens and the street.
capabilities.worlds.title: Brand worlds
capabilities.worlds.short: A familiar world with room to grow.
capabilities.worlds.description: We build a visual language your brand can keep creating from. Our team develops environments, characters, visual styles and motion language with generative AI, finding the details that make the world recognisable as new stories unfold.
capabilities.worlds.note: Familiar enough to recognise, open enough to evolve.
capabilities.worlds.scopes.6: Motion and stills from a shared world
capabilities.development.title: Creative development
capabilities.development.short: See what an idea could become.
capabilities.development.description: Treatments, visual explorations and key moments give early thoughts a shape you can respond to. We test the tricky parts before production begins.
capabilities.development.note: A chance to see it before we make it.
capabilities.finishing.title: Production & finishing
capabilities.finishing.short: Time for the details that bring it together.
capabilities.finishing.description: We manage production and bring in our specialist collaborators for the edit, imagery, colour and sound, through to final delivery.
capabilities.finishing.note: Files prepared for wherever the work will live.
approach.define.name: Define
approach.define.title: Tell us what you have in mind.
approach.define.description: We talk about the idea, who it’s for and what you want them to feel. Then we agree the scope, the people involved and the details to get right.
approach.prove.name: Prove
approach.prove.title: Test the difficult bit first.
approach.prove.description: We explore visual directions and test the demanding elements before committing to production.
approach.prove.output: Key frames and a tested approach.
approach.build.name: Build
approach.build.title: See the idea start to take shape.
approach.build.description: Our creative team develops the images and sequences, working through light, composition and movement. Any filmed or photographed elements come together here.
approach.review.name: Review
approach.review.title: Let’s look at it together.
approach.review.description: We look at the work together, gather your feedback and agree the revisions, checking that each change holds up across the whole piece.
approach.finish.name: Finish
approach.finish.title: Bring all the details together.
approach.finish.description: We refine the edit, image, colour, sound and typography, then check the files against the delivery specifications.
approach.extend.name: Extend
approach.extend.title: Find the next story in this world.
approach.extend.description: We carry the agreed assets, visual style and motion language into the next format, story or campaign.
approach.extend.output: Existing work adapted for a new brief.

hero.title:
Multipliers of
Brand Potential
hero.description: We combine human creative expertise and taste with the creative power of AI to multiply brands’ potential to drive more commercial impact.
hero.cta: Have a look at our work
difference.label: Our point of view
difference.title:
More of what
we imagine.
difference.description: Generative AI gives us more ways to bring an idea to life. Our people shape it into work with a point of view.
difference.fieldDetail: The idea leads. The craft makes it happen.
difference.character.label: 01 / Character
difference.character.title: A character of its own.
difference.character.description: We shape the work around your idea, your brand and the people you want to reach. Every image and every frame should feel like it belongs.
difference.collaboration.label: 02 / Collaboration
difference.collaboration.title: Made with you.
difference.collaboration.description: You’re part of the process, with clear moments to see the work, share your thoughts and decide what happens next.
difference.craft.label: 03 / Craft
difference.craft.title: Care in every detail.
difference.craft.description: From the first image to the final edit, we give the details the attention they need. Colour, sound and finishing bring the whole piece together.

commission.title:
Bring us in from the beginning,

commission.world.title: Keep building your brand’s world.
commission.world.description: Keep working with us across campaigns, drawing on an established visual style and motion language as new briefs come in.

and follow it into the work.

diagrams.production.generative.title: Make a world we can imagine.
diagrams.production.generative.descripti: Our creative team develops the imagery and motion, shaping generated material into a finished piece.
diagrams.production.generative.detail: For scenes that would be difficult to capture.
diagrams.production.capture.name: AI with film & photography
diagrams.production.capture.title: Build on what we can capture.
diagrams.production.capture.description: We build generated elements around filmed or photographed material, bringing in our specialist partners where the idea calls for them.
diagrams.production.capture.detail: For work that needs a particular performance, place or product.
diagrams.production.specialist.name: Specialist input
diagrams.production.specialist.title: Bring us into the part you need.
diagrams.production.specialist.descripti: We can create a sequence, an environment or a particular visual element within a larger production. Our creative team works alongside yours, developing the material so it feels at home in the finished piece.
diagrams.production.specialist.detail: For a specific part of a larger brief.
diagrams.process.define.explanation: Two separate fields establish the intent and the possibilities, with a small point of connection.
diagrams.process.prove.explanation: A small overlap puts the idea and a real test in contact, before committing to full production.
diagrams.process.build.explanation: The two fields form a broad overlap as creative direction and production develop together.
diagrams.process.review.explanation: A retained outline marks the agreed direction. A controlled offset compares the work against it.
diagrams.process.finish.explanation: The two fields align against registration marks, bringing the work into a resolved final composition.
diagrams.process.extend.explanation: The finished pair becomes three related crops, preserving a recognisable idea across different formats.
diagrams.judgement.title: Human creativity, multiplied with generative AI.
diagrams.judgement.description: A bowed violet field meets an angular lilac field. Fine marks reveal new folds in their overlap, illustrating how generative AI expands what our people can make. Move across the field to discover the overlap. With keyboard focus, use the left and right arrows.
diagrams.judgement.resultDescription: More room to explore what an idea could become.
diagrams.production.artDescription: A curved violet field meets an angular lilac field. A third pattern appears in their intersection. The overlap shifts for each approach; our team shapes the generative AI work throughout.
diagrams.production.note: We choose the approach around what the work needs.
diagrams.process.artDescription: {explanation} The left source is bowed with long violet marks; the right is angular with short lilac dashes. Their intersection reveals a third pattern.
motion.instructions: The optical fields respond to mouse movement and scrolling. Press Escape to pause or resume motion.
optical.folds.description: Closely spaced violet fields overlap, creating broad folds of light within a continuous curved form.
optical.slices.description: Overlapping violet fields are seen through a close crop, revealing a soft fold of light and fine parallel lines.
optical.overlap.description: Two violet fields share one continuous curved form. Fine parallel lines create shifting light across the overlap.
optical.interactiveHint: Move across the field to shift the alignment. With keyboard focus, use the arrow keys.
optical.stillHint: A still study of overlapping violet fields.

home.production: We use AI and hybrid AI/live action production to make commercials, brand and corporate videos, video content and still images that deliver more bang for less buck.
home.reel.title: Studio reel
home.echo.instructions: Press Escape to pause or resume the mascot animation and decorative motion.
home.echo.label: Doppl mascot and its echoes. Use the arrow keys to explore, Home to reset, and Escape to pause motion.
home.diagram.description: Human creative direction guides generative AI production, carrying a shared brand identity through film and video, still imagery and brand worlds.
home.studio.title:
Creatively driven,
Commercially optimised
home.studio.creative: Our creative team combines the experience and expertise of creatives and producers with backgrounds in advertising, design and film with Generative AI specialists. When appropriate, we also draw on a network of some of Australia’s most accomplished film directors, image makers and artists to deliver a sensibility and singularity of vision that is second to none.
home.studio.strategy: Our approach is also grounded in established marketing science, recognising that brand growth depends on building and reinforcing distinctive brand assets that strengthen mental availability. By helping our clients consistently deploy recognisable brand cues across multiple platforms and touchpoints, we build stronger, more enduring memory structures that make brands easier to recognise, recall and choose.
home.studio.worlds: We create brand worlds that enable our clients to show up in more places, on more platforms in more formats, without requiring more budget.
home.engagement.title: How we work
home.engagement.idea.title: You’ve generated an idea that you want produced?
home.engagement.idea.description: No problem. We provide an expert point of view on the most impactful way to bring your team’s vision to life and make it happen. Our process means you’re involved at every key stage of production, so the only surprise is how great the final product is.
home.engagement.idea.cta: Talk to us about your idea
home.engagement.idea.subject: An idea for DOPPL
home.engagement.brand.title: You need your brand to show up in more places and formats for less budget?
home.engagement.brand.description: We hear you. There are a couple of ways we can go with this:
home.engagement.assets.title: Build on what you have
home.engagement.assets.description: We work with your existing brand guidelines and brand assets and provide cost-effective creative and production solutions for how your brand can engage its audience across a full range of touchpoints, with consistently refreshed creative.
home.engagement.world.title: Create a new brand world
home.engagement.world.description: We translate your brand strategy into the creation of a fresh new “brand world” that’s specifically designed to enable the production of consistently refreshed creative executions across any format or platform that you require. If you’re looking for a steadfast way to optimise both marketing effectiveness and cost efficiency, this is for you.
